title: A narrowed member does not leak past the match: T has reverted, member access fails
expectedDiagnosticContains: cannot access field `price` on union type
notes: rfd#56 phase 2: the arm-scope shadowing that narrows T pops with the arm. After the match, item: T again — and T is only matchable, not field-accessible, exactly like an ordinary union value. DekaScript has no flow-sensitive typing.
